_comment: Plane-4 standing tool-surface baseline (scripts/check-tool-surface.mjs). Growth is ALLOWED but never silent: raise a value and record `reason` + `recordedAt` saying what capability it buys. Dispatch-time caps are governed elsewhere and are not the subject of this baseline.

registry.toolDefinitions.reason: Relocation, not growth (W9, BI-0E7B0953): saveBuildEvidence, reviewDesignDoc and reviewBuildPlan moved verbatim out of the mcp-tools.ts legacy monolith (which this guard never counted) into build-review-pack. The model-facing tool surface is unchanged — the same three frozen names were already served from PLATFORM_TOOLS; they now live where every other tool lives.

registry.packFiles.reason: Adds build-review-pack (the last three executeTool inline cases, W9 BI-0E7B0953) and backlog-update-item-handler.ts relocated from the deleted lib/mcp-handlers/ third-generation home. Both are relocations of existing capability into the single pack generation, not new surface.

tier.coreToolNames.reason: Promotes find_coworker into the lean core tier so peer CLIs without client-side ToolSearch (Grok, Codex) can discover the coworker roster to route A2A handoffs — same rationale that keeps principle_decide/wiki_query core. Discovery-only; execution still gates on grants. BI-5FB59BC6.
